name: Hara Katsu! 3 ~Kozukuri Business Haigyou no Kiki!?~
original_name: はらかつ！3 ～子作りビジネス廃業の危機！？～
source:
One day, the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare, which is developing support measures for couples struggling with infertility, receives a letter.

It details the existence of a malicious office that is brazenly engaging in a "pregnancy business," or "harakatsu" for short.

Apparently, it's a wicked business that exploits women's desire to become pregnant, and the letter was from an anonymous woman who had been a victim.

"I can't forgive this! Of course I want children, but I don't want just any child."

--Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare official, Chizuru Kushiyanagi, immediately begins an investigation.

After gathering information around the office and becoming certain, Chizuru heads to the corrupt office, "Ichinowatari Detective Agency."

Meanwhile, at the problematic "Ichinowatari Detective Agency"...

The office is run by clerk Natsuko Houjou, and the director, Touya Ichinowatari, frequently visits his girlfriend Iori Shimofurutachi's office. The crucial sperm donation is handled by a handsome colleague of Touya's.

The protagonist of this story, Saeki Kousei, originally specialized in investigating the entertainment industry. Using his connections, he seemed to be doing reasonably well with the Harakatsu business, even successfully bringing in women seeking sperm donations.

Natsuko, constantly bothered by him, grumbles and complains every day, but still energetically manages the office.

Then, Kushiyanagi Chizuru from the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare bursts in...

"I, Kushiyanagi Chizuru, will be cracking down on your unethical business."

What will become of Harakatsu, and Ichinowatari Detective Agency?

A new Harakatsu begins now!!!
